title: Founder’s Associate – Operations & AI (all genders)
description: Über TradeLink TradeLink baut agentische Plattformen, die europäische Lieferketten auf ein neues Level bringen. Routineaufgaben werden dabei von intelligenten KI-Agenten übernommen, wichtige Entscheidungen und Priorisierungen bleiben in den Teams. Ein Netzwerk, das Unternehmen, Lieferanten und Spediteure verbindet, sorgt für maximale Transparenz, reduziert Zeitverluste und schafft einen sicheren und vertrauensvollen Prozess. Mit TradeLink hat man seine Logistik jederzeit im Griff, statt ihr hinterherzurennen. Über die Rolle Wir sind intern auf dem Weg zur AI-native Org. Unser Firmenwissen liegt in einem Git-Repo, aus dem AI schöpft und arbeitet und das sich über Feedback Loops selbst aktualisiert. Inbound-Anfragen, Pod-Reports, Support-Triage und Call-Recaps laufen über Agenten und Automationen, die wir selbst gebaut haben. Mehr als 20 davon sind in Produktion. In dieser Rolle bist du für das Backbone von TradeLink zuständig: die Systeme und Abläufe in Operations, People, Finance und GTM , auf die sich alle Teams jeden Tag verlassen. Du treibst AI-Projekte in der ganzen Firma voran und machst unsere Abläufe schlanker, schneller und effizienter. Dabei bekommst du Einblick in alle Bereiche des Unternehmens, vom Vertrieb über Produkt und Kunden bis zu People und Finance. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und Gründer Tobias und mit Daniel, unserem Chief of Staff und AI Enablement Manager , zusammen und machst die Firma jede Woche ein Stück besser. Für dich ist die Rolle ein Sprungbrett: Von hier aus kannst du dich in jeden Unternehmensbereich weiterentwickeln, der zu dir passt. Dein Verantwortungsbereich People & Finance Operations AI-first umbauen: Du übernimmst unsere People- und Finance-Abläufe, verschlankst sie und automatisierst sie Schritt für Schritt. Das Ziel: Abläufe laufen pünktlich, haben einen Prüfschritt und finden Fehler, bevor sie beim Empfänger ankommen. Operations schlank und kosteneffizient halten: Du behältst im Blick, wofür wir Geld und Zeit ausgeben, und sorgst dafür, dass wir effizient bleiben. Dafür prüfst du laufend Tools, Verträge und Abläufe, findest Doppelarbeit und Medienbrüche und managst Kündigungen, Nachverhandlungen, Implementierungen und Vereinfachungen Arbeit an Agenten übergeben: Du betreibst laufende Automationen mit (Make, Claude, HubSpot, GitLab) und baust neue für wiederkehrende Arbeit in Vertrieb, Support, Reporting, People und Finance. Vor jedem Projekt legst du fest, woran wir den Erfolg messen, etwa gesparte Stunden, weniger Fehler oder erzeugte Pipeline. GTM-Systeme und Customer Enablement: Du fährst Outbound-Kampagnen für unsere Zielaccounts und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Weg von der Anfrage bis zum ersten Gespräch schnell bleibt. Du baust das Reporting mit, über das unsere Teams ihre Accounts steuern. Außerdem arbeitest du am AI-native Self-Onboarding mit: Aus deinen Analysen leiten wir Builds ab, die Kundenanfragen und damit Tickets reduzieren. Das Firmen-Gehirn weiterentwickeln: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Firmenwissen (Positionierung, Personas, Plays, Account Maps) aktuell ist und genutzt wird. Du zeigst Teams, wie sie damit arbeiten, misst, ob sie es tun, und verbesserst es, wenn nicht. Nach 90 Tagen laufen unsere Standardprozesse in People, Finance und GTM spürbar runder, schlanker und mit mehr Automatisierung als heute, kennst du die Firma in der ganzen Breite und weißt, wie die Bereiche zusammenhängen, erkennst du, wo es hakt, kannst Abläufe und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen und unterstützt das Management-Team so, dass es sich auf die wichtigen Entscheidungen konzentrieren kann nutzt ein Team mindestens eine Lösung, die du gebaut hast, und spart dadurch jede Woche Zeit. Nach 12 bis 18 Monaten verantwortest du einen Bereich selbst. Wohin es geht, entscheiden wir zusammen: GTM Engineering, Operations, AI Transformation Consultant beim Kunden, Product Builder oder der Weg in Richtung Chief of Staff. Was du mitbringst Du hast mit AI oder Automationen etwas gebaut, das andere nutzen, und kannst es zeigen. Womit, ist egal: Make, n8n, Claude Code, ein Custom GPT mit eigenem Kontext, ein Python-Skript. Erste Erfahrung in einem Startup, Scale-up, in der Beratung oder im VC . Praktika, Werkstudium oder eine eigene Gründung zählen. Du prüfst AI-Output , bevor du ihn weitergibst, und kannst erklären, wo deine Tools versagen. Du schreibst klar : kurze Memos und Anleitungen, mit denen jemand ohne dich weiterarbeiten kann. Du bist sicher mit Zahlen und merkst, wenn eine Summe nicht stimmen kann. Du gehst sorgfältig mit vertraulichen Informationen um. Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und gutes Englisch . Du lernst jede Woche etwas Neues über AI und weißt genau, was du dir zuletzt selbst beigebracht hast Pluspunkte: Erfahrung in Recruiting, People Operations, Billing oder Finance Operations, eine Outbound-Kampagne, die du schon selbst gefahren hast, Git und Markdown, etwas Python oder SQL, HubSpot. Die Stelle passt nicht, wenn du eine Assistenzrolle mit Kalender und Reiseplanung suchst, du mit ChatGPT arbeitest, aber noch nichts gebaut hast, das jemand anderes nutzt, du erst loslegst, wenn ein fertiges Briefing vorliegt, du Strategie machen und die Umsetzung anderen überlassen willst. Was wir dir bieten Bauen ab Woche 1: Claude, ChatGPT und das Tool-Budget, das deine Builds brauchen, und eine Führungskraft, die selbst baut. Breite, die es selten gibt: GTM, AI, Operations in einer Rolle, direkt mit dem Management. Impact, Innovation & Ownership: Gestalte unser schnell wachsendes, AI-natives B2B-Startup in der Logistik mit. Wir arbeiten in kleinen, fokussierten Pods, in denen jede:r echte Ergebnisse verantwortet – nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeitet. Nimm Einfluss auf Produkt, Kundenlösungen, Wachstum und Marke. Wir denken groß, handeln schnell und lösen echte Probleme. AI-Powered, Human-Led: Arbeite an vorderster Front einer Organisation, die AI-nativ aufgebaut ist. Du nutzt AI, um deinen Impact zu vervielfachen – während Urteilsvermögen, Kreativität und Ownership klar menschlich bleiben. Schnell lernen und wachsen: Kontinuierliches Feedback, 360°-Reviews und ein eigenes Development-Budget, um genau die Skills aufzubauen, die du brauchst. Arbeite eng mit einem erfahrenen Managament Team zusammen, die Richtung vorgeben – statt deinen Alltag im Detail zu steuern. Leidenschaftliches Team: Werde Teil eines motivierten, unterstützenden Teams, das Klarheit, Ownership und echten Impact schätzt. In unseren Pods arbeitest du in engen, eingespielten Teams – mit echter Zusammenarbeit statt nur geteilten Tools. Kultur & Zugehörigkeit: Inklusiv, divers und mit Spaß an der Sache – von virtuellen Team-Events bis zu unvergesslichen Offsites schaffen wir überall ein starkes Gemeinschaftsgefühl, inklusive regelmäßigem gemeinsamem Co-Working in Berlin und München. Am Erfolg beteiligt sein: Über unser VSOP-Programm hast du direkten Anteil am Wachstum des Unternehmens Klingt nach einem Match? Dann lass uns sprechen. Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Mareike Buzzoni (Head of People and Culture) Auch wenn du dir nicht zu 100 % sicher bist, ob du alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Neugier, Begeisterung für digitale Innovation, Lernbereitschaft, Teamgeist und eine echte Growth-Mindset-Mentalität sind für uns am wichtigsten. TradeLink ist fest davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt eine große Stärke ist, und setzt sich für ein respektvolles, sicheres und offenes Umfeld für alle ein, die bei oder mit uns arbeiten. Um unbewusste Vorurteile im Bewerbungsprozess zu reduzieren, kannst du dein Bewerbungsfoto gern weglassen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: PhD Research Intern, 3D World Models
description: SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments. We're looking for bold, innovative individuals driven by a passion for pushing the boundaries of generative 3D AI. You should thrive in an environment where creativity meets technical challenge and be fearless in tackling the hardest problems in 3D world modeling. Our team is built on a foundation of dedication and a shared commitment to excellence, so we value people who take immense pride in their work and place the collective goals of the team above personal ambition. As a part of SpAItial, you'll be at the forefront of building World Models that bridge generative AI and the physical world. If you're ready to make an impact, embrace the unknown, and collaborate with a talented group of visionaries, we want to hear from you. We're seeking PhD Research Interns to work with our research team on open problems in 3D generation and reconstruction. You should have strong knowledge of at least one of our core areas, such as generative video and diffusion models, scene representations like Gaussian splats and radiance fields, or 3D reconstruction from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. Over a 5-7 month internship, you will own a well-defined research question with the goal of publishing a paper. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You’re a Fellow at Augustus, deployed to special projects across engineering, product, and the wider company. You own a project end to end: understand the problem, decide how to approach it, build the solution, and get it into use.

The work depends on where you can have the most impact. You could build background coding agents, create a frontend component library, or solve an operational problem with agents. The common thread is a meaningful problem, a clear outcome, and ownership of getting it done.

You’ll work closely with the team your project sits in. They provide context, technical guidance, and direct feedback. You bring the drive to turn an open-ended problem into something that works. As you deliver, the scope and difficulty of your projects grow.

Your First Months

Get context quickly, ship early, and take on harder problems as you prove yourself.

  • Month 1: Join a team, understand the problem, and take ownership of your first project. Talk to the people who will use what you build, agree on what success looks like, and ship an initial version.

  • Months 2–3: Drive the project through to adoption. Work through technical decisions, collect feedback, and improve the solution. You’re becoming more independent and developing better judgment about where to spend your time.

  • Months 4–6: Take on a larger project or a harder problem, potentially in another team. You can turn an ambiguous brief into a plan, make sound tradeoffs, and deliver with less guidance.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We care most about your trajectory, drive, and curiosity. You don’t need years of experience. You need evidence that you learn quickly, push yourself, and finish things.

  • Steep trajectory. You’re getting better fast. The problems you can solve today are meaningfully harder than those you could solve six months ago. You seek feedback and put it to work.

  • Drive. You make things happen. You find a way through unfamiliar problems, follow up without being chased, and stay with a project until it works.

  • Curiosity. You want to understand how things work and why. You dig into unfamiliar systems, ask precise questions, and look beyond the first plausible answer.

  • Ownership. You care about the outcome. You involve the right people, raise blockers early, and check that what you shipped actually solves the problem.

Deine Rolle im Unternehmen

Wir sind ein vierköpfiges HR-Team und kümmern uns gemeinsam um das Recruiting für unsere über 20 Standorte deutschlandweit. Dabei wird es mit unterschiedlichen Berufsbildern, spannenden Persönlichkeiten und immer neuen Herausforderungen garantiert nicht langweilig.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) lernst Du den Recruiting-Prozess von A bis Z kennen, bringst Dich aktiv ein und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Aufgaben. Natürlich lassen wir Dich dabei nicht ins kalte Wasser springen. Wir zeigen Dir, worauf es ankommt, und stehen Dir bei Fragen zur Seite.

Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

  • Du erstellst und veröffentlichst Stellenanzeigen auf verschiedenen Recruiting-Plattformen

Was Dich auszeichnet

Wir suchen keinen fertigen Recruiting-Profi. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass Du neugierig bist, mitdenkst und Freude daran hast, gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen.

  • Recruiting und Kommunikation interessieren Dich und Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu

  • Du bist fit im Umgang mit digitalen Tools und findest Dich schnell in neue Programme ein

  • Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab

  • Und wenn Du Dich auch noch für Social Media begeisterst? Umso schöner! Das ist ein Pluspunkt, aber kein Muss

Deine Vorteile bei uns

  • Ein offenes, hilfsbereites Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

Sie begegnen anspruchsvollen Kunden auf Augenhöhe, sprechen mit dem Sattler über Nahtbilder und behalten zehn Aufträge parallel im Blick, ohne dass einer aus dem Raster fällt. B. Microsoft Business Central) und MS Office Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch, Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen für Übergaben Was uns zusätzlich überzeugt Erfahrung mit BMW oder anderen Premium-Marken Erfahrung mit Individualisierungsprogrammen, Fahrzeugkonfiguration oder Kleinserien Erfahrung mit Kundenevents, Clienteling oder Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit (z. Eine Marke, die noch Spielraum hat: Wir sind groß genug für echte Budgets und klein genug, dass deine Handschrift Sichtbar wird. DEINE AUFGABEN Strategie & Konzeption Du entwickelst die Content-Strategie für unsere Performance-Kanäle (insbesondere Meta) und unseren Onlineshop – von der übergeordneten Creative-Roadmap bis zum einzelnen Ad-Konzept. Wir suchen für diese Rolle bewusst ein starkes Profil – jemanden, der schon unter Beweis gestellt hat, was hier erwartet wird. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns auf dich. Benefits DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Sortiments- & Preismanagement: Du behältst die Performance unserer Produkte im Blick, entwickelst unsere Preisstrategien weiter und identifizierst Potenziale für neue Produkte und Sortimente. Internationalisierung: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau neuer internationaler Marktplätze, analysierst Marktpotenziale und entwickelst Strategien für eine erfolgreiche Expansion. Marketplace Operations: Du stellst einen reibungslosen Marktplatzbetrieb sicher, überwachst Produktverfügbarkeiten, Account Health und Listing-Qualität und arbeitest eng mit unserem E-Commerce- und Supply-Chain-Team zusammen. Strategisches Sparring: Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern zusammen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und hilfst dabei, unsere Marketplace-Strategie datenbasiert weiterzuentwickeln und unternehmerische Entscheidungen zu treffen. **Dein Background **· Ausbildung/Studium: BWL, E-Commerce, Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Marketplace Know-how: Gutes Verständnis von Marktplatzmechanismen, Produktlistings, SEO, Advertising und relevanten Performance-Kennzahlen. Analytisches Mindset: Du denkst datengetrieben, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis relevanter KPIs. Tool Skills: Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Marketplace-Tools, Analyseplattformen und Automatisierungen. Sprachskills: Verhandlungssicheres Englisch, weitere Fremdsprachen sind ein Plus. **Deine Benefits **· Flexibilität: Arbeiten im Office in Hamburg-Mitte, remote oder sogar temporär aus dem Ausland. · Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage. · Gründer-Sparring: Direkter Austausch mit den Gründern statt Konzernpolitik. · Team-Spirit: Regelmäßige Team-Events & jährliche Workation im Ausland. · Karriereperspektive: Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up. · Markenstolz: Teil einer emotionalen Outdoor Brand mit großer Vision. · Modernes Setup: Apple-Hardware & effiziente Tools. · Nach deinen Wünschen: Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports oder Firmenfahrrad. 👉 Bewirb dich noch heute und werde Teil von Nordmut – gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass Menschen überall draußen Abenteuer erleben können. The Role

We are seeking a Device Reliability Testing Engineer to drive reliability qualification, failure analysis, and accelerated life testing for our integrated graphene photonics products. In close collaboration with Design Enablement, Process Integration, and Product Quality, you will establish robust test methodologies to validate device reliability, and long-term stability in accordance with industry standards.

You will play a key role in transitioning our technology from prototype to production- qualified products, ensuring that graphene photonics meet the performance and robustness requirements of high-volume deployment.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Design and execute wafer-level device reliability test plans for graphene- based photonic devices (DC bias, RF endurance, thermal cycling, long-term stability)

  • Identify and investigate the physical mechanisms of graphene-related failure modes.

  • Characterize and monitor key performance metrics, including extinction ratio, insertion loss, bandwidth retention, energy efficiency, dark current stability, responsivity degradation over device lifetime

  • Drive structured root cause investigations using FMEA/8D methodologies and feed findings back to Design and Process teams

  • Work together with product and quality teams to reach compliance with industry standards (JEDEC, OIF, IEC, IEEE) and generate qualification and reliability documentation

  • Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or Photonics Engineering

  • Hands-on experience in semiconductor device physics, optoelectronics, or reliability engineering

title: Senior Account Executive, DACH (German-speaking, Hamburg)
company: Senior Software Engineer, Gamified Security Awareness (Full-Stack)
description: Our mission and why it matters We are on a mission to make humans the strongest security layer. Human risk remains one of the biggest vulnerabilities and traditional awareness training is not enough. We take a different approach by combining AI-driven personalization, real threat detection, and behavioral science to actively protect people and organizations. We don't just simulate risks. We build the tools that detect and stop them. Why this role matters The DACH region is currently our largest growth market in EMEA, generating an incredible amount of pipeline. With a highly certified product and an exceptional service that customers genuinely love, we have laid a strong foundation. We are now looking for a highly self-motivated Senior Account Executive who excels at taking those enterprise opportunities, multi-threading to economic buyers, and guiding them successfully through complex procurement cycles. You will be joining a team that has already proven it can support companies in seeing the value of the service, making this a prime opportunity to drive significant revenue rather than a speculative territory. Crucially, as our business results grow, you will be instrumental in helping us lay the groundwork for our future local hub in the Hamburg area. What you’ll own and drive You will take full ownership of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in the DACH market, expertly guiding deals from initial pipeline through complex procurement to closed-won. Driving multi-threaded deals is second nature to you, as you reach economic buyers early and confidently hold the line on price objections. You will lead POC-led selling initiatives with real, concrete exit criteria to ensure successful outcomes, all while partnering closely with an SDR to prioritize opportunities and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene with customer-owned next steps. What success looks like • In your first 3 months you'll be fully onboarded, deeply understand our qualification framework, and have a few opportunities moving past the initial stages with real, dated next steps. • By month 6, you'll operate independently, managing an active pipeline, progressing opportunities consistently to late stage pipeline, and building your new business ARR towards quota. What makes you thrive here You have native-level or full business proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English, and several years of experience as a closing AE in B2B SaaS. Specifically, you have a proven track record of taking deals through procurement in fast-paced software or licensing sales, rather than just generating them. You bring a strong commercial backbone and comfort with multi-threading to an economic buyer before a proposal ever goes out. Above all, you have a team-first mindset with forecast honesty—you own your pipeline and embrace a collaborative, winning-together attitude. You are a true self-starter who is phenomenal at what you currently do, taking pride in driving significant impact as a senior individual contributor. To support our near-future vision of opening a physical hub in Germany, we are looking for candidates who are ideally already based in the wider Hamburg region. Bonus points if you also bring experience with 3 to 6 month enterprise buying cycles and committees, or prior exposure to regulated DACH verticals like manufacturing, healthcare, or financial services. A background in cybersecurity, GRC, or compliance software is highly valued, as is a habit of leveraging technology creatively in your daily workflow. Who you’ll work with You will be a key part of our EMEA Sales Team, reporting to our EMEA Head of Sales. This DACH-focused role is working in a highly supportive AE group focusing on the EMEA market. We are committed to a collaborative culture but you will also be given independence to run your opportunities. You will find a team that asks for something back on every concession, owns their forecast misses honestly, and truly lives by a team-first standard that shows up in how we actually operate, rather than just as an aspiration on a slide. What you can expect from us • Compensation: Monthly fixed base salary of € 6000 - € 7000 depending on your experience (plus a 50/50 base and commission model featuring accelerated earnings for the first 12 months). You may notice varying salary ranges for roles with similar titles across Hoxhunt; this is because each range is grounded in our role leveling and reflects the seniority, scope, and impact expectations required for that specific role and team, and we operate with a low hierarchy. • Working ways: You will start by working remotely from the Hamburg region. However, as we are planning to build a hub in Hamburg in the near future, this will eventually transform into a hybrid role. You will enjoy a flexible work setting with opportunities to travel and connect with the broader team. • High performance meets high humanity: We bring an incredibly driven, high-impact energy to our work, but we leave our egos at the door. You will be surrounded by wildly talented, dedicated colleagues in an environment built on extreme kindness, support, and psychological safety. • Authentic trust & autonomy: We hire great people and trust them to do great work. You will find a culture free of micromanagement, giving you the autonomy to take real ownership, drive impact, and shape things early on. • A product you can be proud of: It is incredibly rare in cybersecurity to build a multi-award-winning product that end-users genuinely love. You will join a fast-paced, technically sophisticated team making a real, measurable impact against cybercrime, backed by strong financial stability and growth. • The perks that matter: Alongside this amazing community, you will enjoy extensive healthcare with other benefits tailored for our team in Germany. title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
description: ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. Objective of the role We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. The team You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. Responsibilites Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. Requirements 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable. Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking. Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective. You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output. Knowledge of GraphQL. It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres). What we're looking for You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them. You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment. You focus on building a great product. You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information. The interview process We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry. There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague. We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion. You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals. Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You will be accountable, alongside Product Development teams, for the reliability, cost-efficiency and security posture of everything we run in production. What you will do: Leadership across two teams Directly lead, develop and retain a small team of six (6) experienced engineers across Cloud Infrastructure and Security. Establish clear KPIs, SLOs and risk metrics, and report regularly to leadership on reliability, cost and security posture. Set the operating model: what product teams self-serve behind guardrails versus what your teams own centrally.  Foster a culture where reliability and security are shared accountabilities, not tickets thrown over a wall, including establishing a Security Champions model across engineering. Cloud infrastructure, reliability and platform Own our AWS and GCP footprint end to end: EKS, networking, secrets (Vault), data stores (RDS/Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache, MongoDB Atlas, OpenSearch) and the edge (Cloudflare). Establish real reliability engineering practice: SLOs and error budgets, capacity planning, and a business continuity plan. Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity: Automating Terraform change application, advancing our move to GitOps (ArgoCD), and enforcing guardrails at creation time with policy-as-code (Kyverno/OPA) so provisioning is safe, self-serve and reviewable. Consolidate observability into a single source of truth for metrics, logs and traces. Improve developer experience and delivery throughput: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), paved roads, test environments on demand, and delivery metrics that hold up. Own FinOps : infrastructure cost per unit of business value, cost accountability pushed back to each team, and continued run-rate reduction. Cost discipline is a first-class objective. Support the modernisation of our core platform: Tech migrations, runtime and framework upgrades, and continuous database and Kubernetes upgrades. Attack toil systematically: automate the recurring requests, and hand safe self-service back to product teams rather than absorbing the work. Grow the foundations for AI-augmented engineering and operations Security Own security strategy and posture across cloud, application, identity, detection and response, building and improving the governance: risk register, published roadmap, remediation SLAs, and a recurring reporting cadence for leadership. Strengthen cloud security posture management (CNAPP) and secure-by-default configurations across all environments. Improve Embedding security into the SDLC and CI/CD: establish full static-analysis and dependency-scanning coverage with clear criteria for when critical findings block a release. Mature vulnerability management, penetration testing and our bug bounty program into one prioritised program with SLAs and aging reports that measurably reduce risk. Advance identity and access management toward least privilege and zero trust: automated provisioning from groups, and periodic access reviews. Mature logging, detection and incident response, closing SIEM coverage gaps Set guardrails for safe AI adoption (shadow AI outside approved paths, data and prompt leakage, prompt injection, model abuse) and defend against AI-enabled fraud and phishing. Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS v4, NIS2, and CIS v8, including a maintained, reusable evidence library rather than evidence gathered on request. Collaboration with legal and finance teams on compliance and forensic investigation topics Manage third-party and supply-chain risk with vendor tiering and a recurring review cadence. Own the security-built services your team already runs (back-office authentication and ACL, banning/fraud tooling, phone verification) and decide what to keep, hand over or retire. Own endpoint security and partner closely with Corporate IT on device and identity coverage. Keep security awareness and training relevant to a threat landscape that now includes AI-enabled social engineering. Who you are: 8+ years with a Significant experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE or Cloud Security, including experience leading engineers. You may currently be an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or Head of who is ready to broaden your scope and step into a first Director role. Strong practical experience with public cloud, ideally AWS, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code , with the willingness to remain close to architecture, incidents and technical delivery. Track record establishing reliability practice at scale — SLOs, incident management, on-call, capacity planning, disaster recovery. Demonstrable cloud cost optimisation / FinOps results at meaningful scale. Strong grounding in cloud and application security fundamentals — IAM, network security, secrets management, CSPM, OWASP Top 10 — and the judgement to know when to hire the depth you don't have. Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, PCI DSS, NIS2) and how to turn requirements into practical controls. Experience leading through incidents and security events under pressure. Excellent communication skills: able to make a technical trade-off legible to a CFO and a risk decision legible to an engineer. Comfortable operating with a lean team — ruthless prioritisation, automation over headcount, pragmatism over perfection.   Our Tech Stack includes:  AWS cloud (primary), GCP, Kubernetes, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, ArgoCD, Okta. Applications are built on top of PHP 8, Golang and Node.js , using MariaDB, MongoDB and Kafka. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap.</li> <li>Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product.</li> <li>Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt.</li> <li>Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.</li> <li>Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool.</li> <li>Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience</li> <li>Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use</li> <li>Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling</li> <li>A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team</li> <li>Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to Have</h3> <ul> <li>Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling</li> <li>Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents</li> <li>Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python</li> <li>Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer</li> <li>Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption</li> <li>Technical project management experience</li> </ul> <p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. title: Engineering Manager, Experiment Platform, Robot Software
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model. The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software. 🧠 Your day-to-day You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track. You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns. You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches. Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration. Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes. Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases. Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability. Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands. 🙌 You should apply if: You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management. You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field. You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers. You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability. You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer. You care about operational reliability and release quality. Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. This role is based in our London office. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews : leadership and management interview, and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total Deep-dive interviews : domain, systems design and code review interviews; 3 hours total Final interview : values alignment (30-45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Map & Route Team Our Map & Route team sits within Wayve’s Automotive Platforms division in Vehicle Software Engineering, and builds the geospatial foundations behind our AI driver. Working with global-scale data, the team turns road-network and navigation data into reliable products used across Wayve, building geospatial services and data products to support company operations. We work with our model development, experimentation, and evaluation platforms to build an AI driver that uses maps and navigation data like an expert human driver by using map information to enhance training and evaluation of performance. We are a full-stack team owning mapping end to end, getting to touch work that is infrastructure, data engineering, data science, backend and frontend. 🧠 Your day-to-day Write full-stack services in Python and Typescript, creating novel geospatial services to solve challenging and unique problems we face in building our AI driving products. Collaborate with internal teams to understand requirements and build solutions with global geospatial data. Design and build data pipelines with PySpark and Databricks to enrich fleet data with mapping and road-network information at global scale. Build applications and datasets that support route planning and the preparation of map data for training and simulation. Integrate with navigation and mapping APIs from providers such as Mapbox, TomTom and Google Maps. Maintain, support and improve the services the team already runs. Deploy and operate your services on Azure and Kubernetes, owning them end to end. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Global-scale geospatial enrichment pipelines that tell us where we’ve driven and what the road network looks like. Route-planning applications and datasets that help our teams decide where to drive next. Map data preparation for model training and simulation. New services you’ll take from idea to production and lead end to end. 🙌 You should apply if You are a strong, hands-on Python engineer who can deliver high-quality production code at pace. You are comfortable with an AI-assisted or AI engineering workflow (ideation, planning, implementation and review). You have built and operated large-scale data pipelines using Spark or PySpark. You are comfortable writing SQL to query and analyse large datasets. You have working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, ideally Azure and Kubernetes, and are happy to own deployment, monitoring, and observability of your services. You enjoy taking ownership of new services and seeing them through end to end. Experience with geospatial data processing, road-network data or routing engines (e.g. OpenStreetMap, TomTom, HERE or Overture data, PostGIS, navigation APIs) would be a strong advantage. Experience with Bazel or monorepo build systems is desirable but not mandatory. Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Flyte or Airflow would be a bonus. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency interviews : Python Programming (60 mins) and Hiring Manager interview (45 mins) Deep-dive technical interviews : Systems Design (60 mins) and Domain interview (60 mins) Final interview : Mission and Values Alignment (45 mins). We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. raw.title: Software Engineer - Map & Route
raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Map & Route Team

Our Map & Route team sits within Wayve’s Automotive Platforms division in Vehicle Software Engineering, and builds the geospatial foundations behind our AI driver. Working with global-scale data, the team turns road-network and navigation data into reliable products used across Wayve, building geospatial services and data products to support company operations. We work with our model development, experimentation, and evaluation platforms to build an AI driver that uses maps and navigation data like an expert human driver by using map information to enhance training and evaluation of performance. We are a full-stack team owning mapping end to end, getting to touch work that is infrastructure, data engineering, data science, backend and frontend.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Write full-stack services in Python and Typescript, creating novel geospatial services to solve challenging and unique problems we face in building our AI driving products.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to understand requirements and build solutions with global geospatial data.

  • Design and build data pipelines with PySpark and Databricks to enrich fleet data with mapping and road-network information at global scale.

  • Build applications and datasets that support route planning and the preparation of map data for training and simulation.

  • Integrate with navigation and mapping APIs from providers such as Mapbox, TomTom and Google Maps.

  • Maintain, support and improve the services the team already runs.

  • Deploy and operate your services on Azure and Kubernetes, owning them end to end.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Global-scale geospatial enrichment pipelines that tell us where we’ve driven and what the road network looks like.

  • Route-planning applications and datasets that help our teams decide where to drive next.

  • Map data preparation for model training and simulation.

  • New services you’ll take from idea to production and lead end to end.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You are a strong, hands-on Python engineer who can deliver high-quality production code at pace.

  • You are comfortable with an AI-assisted or AI engineering workflow (ideation, planning, implementation and review).

  • You have built and operated large-scale data pipelines using Spark or PySpark.

  • You are comfortable writing SQL to query and analyse large datasets.

  • You have working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, ideally Azure and Kubernetes, and are happy to own deployment, monitoring, and observability of your services.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of new services and seeing them through end to end.

  • Experience with geospatial data processing, road-network data or routing engines (e.g. OpenStreetMap, TomTom, HERE or Overture data, PostGIS, navigation APIs) would be a strong advantage.

  • Experience with Bazel or monorepo build systems is desirable but not mandatory.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Flyte or Airflow would be a bonus.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interviews: Python Programming (60 mins) and Hiring Manager interview (45 mins)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: Systems Design (60 mins) and Domain interview (60 mins)

  • Final interview: Mission and Values Alignment (45 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Your Mission

About the Role
We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Bid Manager to lead and project manage the end-to-end tender and proposal process across our UK business.
You will take ownership of each bid from early qualification and planning through to submission, clarification, handover and post-bid review. This includes setting the bid strategy, defining responsibilities, coordinating contributors, managing timelines and dependencies, and ensuring that decisions and deliverables are completed to the required quality and deadline.
The role requires someone who can bring structure and momentum to complex tender processes, engage stakeholders across different functions and levels, and constructively challenge assumptions, contributions and proposed solutions. Working closely with Commercial, Operations, Delivery, Product, Legal, Finance and central teams, you will ensure that submissions are compliant, compelling, deliverable and commercially robust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full bid lifecycle from opportunity qualification and bid planning through to submission, clarification, contract handover and post-bid review.
  • Develop and maintain clear bid plans covering deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, review stages, approvals, resources and deadlines.
  • Lead bid kick-offs, progress reviews, solution workshops and final submission reviews, creating clarity and accountability across all contributors.
  • Coordinate and actively manage internal stakeholders, external consultants and specialist partners, challenging delays, unclear ownership or insufficient contributions.
  • Identify bid risks, dependencies, gaps and decision requirements early, escalating where necessary to protect quality, commercial viability and timelines.
  • Lead bid qualification and go/no-go assessments, ensuring that client requirements and commercial, technical, operational and delivery implications are fully understood.
  • Develop the bid strategy, win themes, key messages and overall proposal structure in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure that submissions are compliant, persuasive, commercially competitive and operationally deliverable, constructively challenging assumptions and proposed commitments.
  • Own the overall quality and consistency of proposal content, turning cross-functional input into one clear, client-focused response.
  • Maintain an accurate tender pipeline and clear reporting on opportunity status, key dates, resource requirements, risks and decisions.
  • Improve bid-management tools, governance and reusable content, including Jira-based planning and appropriate use of AI-supported bidding solutions.
  • Ensure a structured handover of successful bids, including commitments, assumptions, risks, dependencies, SLAs and implementation obligations, to Delivery and Operations.

Your profile

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience leading complex bids, proposals or tender processes from qualification through to submission and handover.
  • Strong project-management skills, including planning, stakeholder coordination, risk management, governance and action tracking.
  • Confidence coordinating and constructively challenging contributors across different functions and levels of seniority.
  • Ability to create accountability and maintain momentum without relying on formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex input into clear and persuasive proposals.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to understand client priorities, operational constraints and business risks.
  • Ability to identify gaps, dependencies and unrealistic commitments early and drive timely decisions.
  • Highly organised and comfortable managing several concurrent deadlines and changing priorities.
  • Experience with public-sector procurement, framework agreements or infrastructure tenders would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience in EV charging, energy, transport, mobility, utilities or related infrastructure, and familiarity with Jira, CRM or proposal-management tools, would be beneficial.

Our Offer

Location & Ways of Working

Location
ubitricity Distributed Energy Systems UK Ltd.
Spectrum House, Unit 11
32-34 Gordon House Road
London NW5 1LP

We operate a hybrid working model and believe that collaboration is at its best when people spend time together. Employees are expected to work from the office a minimum of three days per week, including our dedicated Face-to-Face Tuesday, which is designed to strengthen cross-team collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation.

Benefits
At ubitricity, we offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, financial security, and professional growth.

Time Off & Flexibility

  • 27 days annual leave plus public holidays
  • Hybrid working model (minimum 3 office days per week)
  • Flexible and collaborative working environment

Health & Wellbeing

  • AXA Private Healthcare with comprehensive cover
  • Company-funded Benefit-in-Kind (BIK) tax and National Insurance contributions related to the healthcare benefit
  • Option to add family members to the healthcare scheme (employee-funded)
  • Access to the Spark Health & Wellbeing Platform, including:
    • 24/7 virtual GP and nursing services
    • Online physiotherapy
    • Confidential counselling support
    • Second medical opinions
    • Cancer and long-term condition support
    • Nutrition, fitness and wellbeing tools
    • Digital gym access

Financial Benefits

  • Choice between comprehensive private healthcare cover or enhanced pension benefits
  • Additional employer pension contribution of:
    • £50 per month for employees enrolled in private healthcare
    • £100 per month for employees who opt out of private healthcare
  • Automatic enrolment into the NEST pension scheme (subject to eligibility)
  • Life Assurance cover of four times annual salary

Additional Benefits

  • Free coffee and healthy snacks in the office
  • Regular social and company events
  • Opportunities to visit and collaborate with colleagues at our Berlin headquarters
  • Access to International SOS for medical and travel assistance during business travel
  • Opportunity to work alongside colleagues from both ubitricity and the wider Shell organisation

Why Join Us?
At ubitricity, we're helping accelerate the transition to electric mobility by delivering innovative EV charging solutions across the UK and Europe. As part of the Shell Group, we combine the agility of a growing technology business with the scale and opportunities of a global organisation.
You'll join a collaborative, international team where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your work has a direct impact on the future of sustainable transport. If you enjoy taking ownership of complex processes, bringing different stakeholders together and turning client requirements into clear, credible and competitive proposals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Research Scientist, Protein Design & Engineering
description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why. This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it. What you'll do Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and characterisation of improved variants. Build and express variant libraries using site-directed, random, and combinatorial mutagenesis. Develop assays and high-throughput screens that reliably measure the properties we're trying to improve. Express, purify, and characterise proteins, measuring kinetics, substrate scope, selectivity, and stability under relevant reaction conditions. Work with computational scientists to test proposed designs, interpret successes and failures, and use the results to guide the next round. Develop enzymatic reactions and cascades, identifying how enzyme performance, cofactors, and reaction conditions affect overall productivity. Essential experience We're interested in the engineering campaigns you've run, the assays you've built, and what you learned from them. We care about: A track record of improving protein or enzyme function through directed evolution or rational engineering. Practical fluency in molecular biology, including cloning, library construction, mutagenesis, and recombinant protein expression. Experience developing and troubleshooting enzyme assays and screening workflows, with appropriate controls and follow-up validation. A solid grasp of enzyme mechanism, kinetics, and structure–function relationships, and the ability to use these to guide experiments. Experience independently taking projects through multiple design–build–test cycles and explaining what drove the results. Highly preferred Experience with industrial biocatalysis or engineering enzymes for demanding reaction conditions. Experience integrating liquid handling and laboratory automation with high-throughput screening. Familiarity with biosensor-based screens, growth-based selection, or FACS. Experience testing computationally designed proteins and feeding experimental results back into design. Experience with enzyme cascades, fermentation, or transferring enzymatic processes from the bench to larger scales. Logistics This is a full-time, on-site role in Cambridge, MA.   • 1-3 years in an Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, or transactional finance role

  • Experience in a fintech, payments, or regulated financial services environment

We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role We are currently seeking an exceptional Senior Strategic Finance Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team. You can be based in either our Barcelona or London office. The Strategic Finance department is responsible for crafting our long-term strategic roadmap and optimizing how we allocate resources to fuel our growth and create lasting value. Reporting to the Senior Director of Strategic Finance, you will be pivotal in shaping the company's operational plan and creating scalable business models. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll be instrumental in translating intricate operational goals into financial outcomes. Your keen analytical skills and effective communication abilities will be put to good use as you cultivate strong relationships throughout the organization. We aim to build a top-tier strategic finance team that prioritizes unwavering accountability. If you're ready to embark on this journey with us, read on! Support for the comprehensive planning and execution of both the long-term strategic plan and the annual operating plan. Utilize an analytical approach to influence strategic decision-making, encompassing capital allocation and long-term financial planning choices. Execute essential financial processes, including reporting, forecasting, budgeting, ROI-based resource allocation, and internal as well as external benchmarking. Monitor crucial performance metrics and offer valuable insights through regular reporting and ad hoc analysis. Data-driven mindset, a bias for rapid decision-making, favouring excellence over perfection. Proficiency in Excel, including the ability to create and manage complex financial models. Strong knowledge of financial statements, accounting principles, and investment analysis. Capability to comprehend and collaborate with various lines of business. Willingness to stretch beyond your comfort zone and embrace new challenges. Openness to feedback, with a commitment to continuous improvement, development, and innovation. Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a quantitative field.
