raw.title: Security Engineer Senior - GRC
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🛡️ The role

Most GRC roles are about keeping auditors happy. This one is about earning our members' trust: every day, they share their diagnoses, their claims and their care with us.

You'll own security governance and risk at Alan end to end. That means one clear framework across our certifications and regulations, which the whole company uses to decide what matters most. You set the direction, make the calls on risk, and help every team own its part.

We just earned our HDS certification, and there's much more to build as we grow from 1M to many millions of members, across more countries and regulators. That includes how we govern AI, which Alan uses across its products and operations.

This is a hands-on senior role. You do the work yourself, mentor the junior GRC engineer we're hiring alongside you, and grow the team over time.

 

🚀 What you'll do

  • Make our security framework a tool for the whole company. You own the full certification cycle (ISO 27001, HDS and those to come), and turn it into something teams use every day to prioritise, not a binder for auditors.

  • Bring the security view on regulation. Legal and Risk own the regulatory relationships. You bring the security answer: what the rules mean for how we protect data, and which controls make it work in practice.

  • Run risk as an ongoing programme. You map and prioritise security risks, including AI risks, turn them into clear treatment plans, and feed them into company-wide risk decisions with the Risk team.

  • Help every team own its risks. You define the controls framework and the standards, while the teams who build and run our systems own the controls. You brief the board and audit committee, and you know which findings need an urgent call and which can wait for the quarterly report.

  • Own incident governance. You triage and escalate incidents, own business continuity and disaster recovery, and shape the security side of our regulatory incident reports.

  • Be a credible partner to engineering. You work with engineering teams early on new designs and spot control gaps (access, encryption, logging) before they ship. You don't need to be an architect, but you can hold the conversation.

     

🏗️ What you'll build

  • One governance model: clear ownership of risks and controls across teams, so security decisions don't bottleneck on one person.

  • A living risk map: prioritised risks that actually drive company and engineering decisions.

  • One compliance backbone: a single control system across our countries and regulators, built to scale.

  • An automated evidence engine: evidence collected straight from engineering systems, so audits run continuously instead of as a quarterly rush.

You'll work closely with Legal, the Data Protection Officer, Internal Audit and Risk, and day to day with engineering and operations teams.

 

⭐ What we're looking for

Your team

You'll join Alan's Corporate team, which brings together our control functions: Risk, Corporate Governance & Internal Control, Legal, Compliance and Security. They share one mission: building what lets Alan operate at scale, safely and responsibly. Within that group, you carry the security governance and risk dimension, working hand in hand with the security engineers who run our infrastructure and platform security, and with a junior GRC engineer we're hiring alongside you. You'll be hands-on every day, building and owning the work yourself. Along the way, you'll mentor the junior engineer and help shape how GRC grows at Alan.

What you bring

  • You want to build and own things yourself, and you enjoy helping someone else grow while you do it.

  • 6+ years in security, with real GRC ownership.

  • You've run a GRC roadmap in a certified or strongly regulated environment (ISO 27001, HDS, SOC 2, or regulated sectors like health, insurance or finance). You're comfortable working with certification auditors, and you can explain what a framework requires and why it makes sense for business teams.

  • You take a stand on risks, and you'd rather close one real risk than write ten policies.

  • You're fluent in French and English.

     

A big plus

  • You've driven a certification or audit cycle end to end yourself.

  • You've automated compliance work, or you're eager to, and you have a view on where AI can help.

  • You've presented risk to senior leaders or a board.

  • You've mentored or onboarded someone before.

🌍 How we work

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France, Belgium or Spain.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility.

 

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

🤘A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.</p> <p>Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.</p> <p>As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.</p> <p>With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Strategic Finance is part of Alma's Finance team and reports to the CFO. Our job is to understand Alma's economics better than anyone: we own the top line, the unit economics and the Contribution Margin, and we turn that knowledge into decisions on pricing, partnerships, markets and products.</p> <p>We are organising the team so that each person owns a piece of Alma's P&amp;L from start to finish: its business plan, its recurring analysis, its key finance processes, its business partners and its Board materials. Depending on the scope, that piece can be payments and partnerships, our existing merchant base, or new business and growth, each with one or more European markets attached.</p> <h2><strong>About the job</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own your piece of the P&amp;L.</strong> Build and maintain its business plan, follow its performance month after month, and explain what moves the numbers and why, all the way up to the Board.</li> <li><strong>Run the key finance processes of your scope.</strong> Depending on the scope: pricing, merchant performance reviews, cost and margin analysis, country reviews. You are accountable for their quality, and for making them better at every cycle.</li> <li><strong>Be a real partner to the business.</strong> Work day to day with the commercial, product and operations teams, step back from the numbers, and bring a clear recommendation whenever a decision is on the table.</li> <li><strong>Rebuild how finance works with AI.</strong> Prototype AI-assisted workflows, industrialise the ones that work, and free up the team's time for analysis and influence. Raising the bar on <em>how</em> we work matters as much as <em>what</em> we deliver.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will work with</strong></h2> <p>Google Sheets · Excel · SQL (largely AI-assisted) · Notion · Slack · AI assistants and LLMs</p> <h2><strong>&nbsp;About you</strong></h2> <p><strong>To succeed in this job</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have 6 to 7 years of experience in strategic finance, FP&amp;A, transaction services, consulting or a similar analytical role, ideally including time in a fast-growing company.</li> <li>Model with ease and think in unit economics: you can build a business plan from raw data and spot when a number doesn't make sense. Ideally, you have already built AI-assisted workflows and made them stick.</li> <li>Take ownership and bring business sense: you make a scope your own, you know when to step back, and you can influence people who don't report to you. You work comfortably in English and have enough French for day-to-day exchanges with colleagues (native French is not required).</li> </ul> <p><strong>And it will be nice if you also</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold a Master's degree in Finance, Business or Engineering, or equivalent.</li> <li>Have exposure to fintech, payments or BNPL.</li> <li>Speak a third language beyond French and English, a real plus given our European footprint.</li> </ul> <p><em>Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</em></p> <h2><strong>What's in it for you</strong></h2> <p>If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership and visibility.</strong> A piece of Alma's P&amp;L that is truly yours, with direct exposure.</li> <li><strong>AI at the core of the job.</strong> The chance to redesign how a finance team works, building the workflows rather than just using them.</li> <li><strong>A team in the making.</strong> Strategic Finance is being restructured now: you will help shape how it works, in a Next40 scale-up growing across Europe, with room to take on broader responsibilities.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary based on 12 months</li> <li>Profit-sharing and employee savings plan</li> <li>Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package</li> <li>Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma</li> <li>Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li>Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.</li> <li>Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)</li> <li>Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma</li> <li>Mental health: free access to MindDay platform</li> <li>Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)</li> <li>Access to our Learning &amp; Development Platform</li> <li>2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview Process</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation &amp; present you the role.</li> <li>Video call with your future manager to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.</li> <li>Case study presentation with 2 - 3 team members (ideally in house) to assess your practical knowledge.</li> <li>1 or 2 additional interviews customized to the role's level to further assess your skills and team fit.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>&nbsp;Diversity &amp; Inclusion</strong></h2> <p><em>At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. description: About Traila At Traila, we are dedicated to shaping the future of rail transport through cutting-edge technology. Since our founding in 2017, we have been driven by a passion for sustainability and excellence. We believe that rail transport is a cornerstone of a greener future, and our mission is to make it quieter, more efficient, and more reliable. Our talented team is at the heart of this mission, and we are looking for an Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications to join us in developing robust software solutions that operate reliably in real-world railway environments. What you will do - Industrial Software Development: Design, implement and maintain robust application software for industrial and railway products using C++, C#, Python or comparable technologies. - Application & System Integration: Translate system and operational requirements into practical software functionality and integrate software with real hardware and physical systems. - Hardware & Device Interfaces: Integrate sensors, actuators, controllers, DAQ systems and other industrial devices. - Communication Protocols: Implement and troubleshoot interfaces such as CAN/CANopen, EtherCAT, TCP/IP and other industrial or vehicle communication protocols. - Controls & Application Logic: Implement state machines, operational logic, control functionality and system behaviour required by the application. - Commissioning & Field Support: Support installation, commissioning and field testing on prototypes, test systems and rail vehicles, including travel to customer and test sites when required. - Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Analyse logs, interfaces and system behaviour to identify root causes and solve software and integration issues efficiently. - Testing & Validation: Develop unit, integration and system-level tests and contribute to HIL/SIL or other validation activities where relevant. - Software Architecture, Quality & Controlled Releases: Own software architecture and release discipline, including configuration and version control, code reviews, test evidence and controlled software releases. - Product Cybersecurity: Own threat assessment, secure access and software updates, vulnerability handling and lifecycle security maintenance; coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences. - Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team. - Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities. - Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems. What you bring - Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience. - Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment. - Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service. - Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed. - Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems. - Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use. - Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable. - Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products. - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces. - Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows. - A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution. - Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly. - Fluent English; German is a strong advantage. Nice to have - Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems. - MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience. - Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable. - Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS. - Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment. Benefits 25 days of annual leave, plus paid bridge days at Christmas. Flexible working hours and home office options. Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences. Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage. A collaborative team culture with regular social and sports activities. Real autonomy and short decision-making paths. If you want your software engineering to have real-world impact in rail, we’d like to hear from you. Contact Yasi Samari, HR Responsible, by applying directly here. description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. The successful candidate will engage the SMA community (and communities for future disease states) to establish and solidify trust and act as a connector to patient and advocate perspectives to drive Scholar Rock’s patient first values. They will act as a trusted strategic advisor to regional leadership and work cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Global patient advocacy and communications, Market Access, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and Commercial Teams, supported by global and regional agency partners. The ideal candidate combines deep understanding of the rare disease community with exceptional communications and stakeholder management capabilities and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial biotech environment.       Position Responsibilities  Patient Advocacy Leadership Develop and Execute Advocacy Strategy Contribute to the development and implementation of a comprehensive EMEA patient advocacy strategy aligned with corporate and regional objectives, starting in the SMA community and building the FSHD relationships. Ensure patient and caregiver perspectives are appropriately incorporated throughout the product lifecycle, from clinical development through commercialization. Identify emerging opportunities and risks within the advocacy and policy environment and provide strategic recommendations to leadership. Foster a patient-centric culture throughout the organization. Build Meaningful Community Partnerships Establish and maintain authentic, trusted relationships with regional and national patient organizations, advocacy leaders, caregivers, and community stakeholders. Serve as the primary company representative to patient advocacy organizations associated with direct-to-market counties throughout EMEA Support development of and monitor execution against a patient advocacy group engagement playbook for partner market countries ensuring advocate engagement follows Scholar Rock standards Identify, deliver, and participate in collaborative initiatives that support disease awareness, education, research, access, and policy priorities. Build long-term collaboration based on transparency, trust, and shared goals. Generate Patient Insights  Execute patient advisory boards, caregiver councils, listening sessions, and community engagement initiatives. Collect and translate patient insights into actionable recommendations for internal teams. Partner with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, and Market Access to ensure the patient voice informs strategic decision-making. Drive initiatives that better understand the patient and caregiver journey across EMEA markets. Corporate Communications Leadership Corporate Reputation & Narrative  Develop and execute a comprehensive EMEA communications strategy that enhances company reputation and stakeholder trust. Shape and implement compelling corporate narratives that articulate the company's mission, vision, scientific innovation, and commitment to patients. Ensure consistency of messaging and brand positioning across all EMEA communications activities. Support the development of disease area leadership and corporate positioning strategies. Media & External Communications Manage regional media relations and proactive communications opportunities. Draft and oversee press releases, corporate announcements, leadership messaging, Q&A documents, and stakeholder communications aligned with relevant global advocacy and communications plans Support major corporate and product milestones and drive the regional comunication plans of key milestones, including regulatory decisions, clinical data presentations, launch activities, and access achievements. Develop digital communications strategies and manage relevant corporate channels aligned with Global Communications plans Monitor emerging issues and develop proactive communications plans and response strategies. Executive Communications & Thought Leadership Partner with senior leaders to enhance visibility and thought leadership within the rare disease community. Develop executive presentations, conference materials, speeches, articles, and strategic messaging. Support participation at patient, scientific, industry, and policy events across EMEA. Position company leaders as credible and trusted voices within the neuromuscular disease ecosystem. Internal Communications Develop internal communication strategies that foster employee engagement and organizational alignment. Support communications related to business updates, organizational initiatives, and company milestones. Reinforce company culture and mission through effective storytelling and employee engagement programs. Ensure employees remain connected to the needs and experiences of patients and caregivers. Cross-Functional Leadership Collaborate closely with Global Advocacy and Communications, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, and Clinical Development Teams. Act as a strategic partner across functions to align patient advocacy and communications initiatives with broader business priorities. Ensure all activities comply with applicable regulations, industry codes, and company policies. Provide patient engagement and communications expertise to internal stakeholders and project teams. Experience 8-12+ years of relevant experience within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or rare diseases. Significant experience in patient advocacy, corporate communications, public affairs, or stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated success working with patient organizations and advocacy communities. Experience supporting products in development, launch, or commercialization preferred. Strong understanding of the rare disease landscape and European healthcare environment. Experience working across multiple European countries and stakeholder groups. Core Competencies Patient-Centric Leadership Passion for improving the lives of patients and caregivers. Ability to build trusted and compliance relationships based on empathy, authenticity, and credibility. Strategic Thinking Ability to connect advocacy and communications initiatives to broader business goals. Strong judgment and ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments. Influencing & Collaboration Exceptional stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to influence without authority and work effectively across functions. Communication Excellence Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex scientific and business topics into clear and compelling messages. Agility & Execution Comfortable operating in a growing biotech environment where strategic thinking and hands-on execution are equally important. Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results with limited resources. What Success Looks Like Within the first 12-24 months, the successful candidate will: Implement an integrated multi-channel advocacy and communications plan for priority markets Establish the company as a trusted partner within the EMEA rare neuromuscular disease community, starting with SMA. title: Staff Software Engineer (Java) - Billing
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description We are looking for a driven, autonomous and impactful Staff Engineer to join the Billing Squad within our StoreFront department . The Billing squad is one of the most cross-functional and fastest growing development teams within Sonar. We enable the release of all the new products that Sonar is currently bringing to the market, both for large and small customers. The AI-native, usage-based nature of our product offering is pushing us to rethink how we develop and implement innovative pricing models. This is pushing us to our limits every day! You will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and other Staff/Principal Engineers across the organization to lead the end-to-end delivery of critical billing features. You will take ownership—from initial architecture and design through to implementation and deployment—of major initiatives ensuring a frictionless yet highly secure experience for millions of developers. What you will do Collaborate with UX designers, Product Management, and engineering teams to deliver robust security features alongside an optimal user experience. Work cross functionally with product squads and go-to-market teams to ensure smooth release of new features and products. Take strong ownership of squad deliverables and effectively drive sprints toward successful completion. Architect and guide the design of our on-premises and AWS cloud applications. Oversee feature deployment, production monitoring, and troubleshoot team-specific live issues. Mentor engineering team members to help them grow in their technical responsibilities and remove blockers to their autonomy. Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals. Experience and qualifications Over 6 years of software engineering experience, including working as a Tech Lead, Staff Engineer, or Software Architect. Proven ability to take initiative and bring a subject involving several stakeholders and engineers to completion with little to no supervision.  Proficiency in working with and steering AI coding tools (Codex, Claude, etc). Experience supporting and mentoring other team members. Proficiency with Java coupled with a strong passion for Clean Code and rigorous software quality standards. Experience architecting cloud-native applications. Experience with relational RDBMS (such as Postgres) and SQL. Über Rivia

Rivia ist ein Technologieunternehmen, das eine Datenplattform entwickelt, die die Zukunft der klinischen Studienanalyse prägt. Rivia wurde aus der Überzeugung heraus gegründet, dass sich neue Medikamente mit einem Bruchteil des heutigen Kapitals erfolgreicher auf den Markt bringen lassen.

Biotech-Unternehmen sind die wichtigste Quelle therapeutischer Innovationen. Ihre klinische Entwicklung wird jedoch immer wieder durch fragmentierte Daten und veraltete Werkzeuge ausgebremst. Rivia führt klinische Studiendaten in großem Maßstab zusammen. Das Herzstück ist eine wiederverwendbare intelligente Datenplattform mit Hunderten von Konfigurationen und studienspezifischen Logiken, die unabhängig von der Struktur der Quelldaten funktioniert. Diese vertikal integrierte Kombination aus Datenplattform, Workflows und KI-Agenten schafft einen entscheidenden Vorteil bei der Durchführung klinischer Studien.

In den vergangenen zwei Jahren haben Biotech-Unternehmen aus Europa und den USA, die mit Rivia weltweit klinische Studien durchführen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielt: von einem früheren Verständnis des therapeutischen Potenzials bis hin zu deutlich effizienteren Studienabläufen. Im März 2026 nahm Rivia in einer Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde 15 Millionen US-Dollar auf, angeführt von Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia will zur Standardinfrastruktur für die moderne Arzneimittelentwicklung werden und die Durchführung klinischer Studien von Anfang bis Ende grundlegend verändern.

Die Rolle

Als Senior Talent & People Partner bist du die erste Verstärkung im People-Team von Rivia. Du bist die enge Sparringspartner:in der Leitung des People-Bereichs: Du denkst selbstständig, arbeitest vertrauensvoll zusammen und packst mit an. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

  • Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

  • Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

  • Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

  • Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

  • Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

 

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

  • Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

    • Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

    • NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

    • JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

  • A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

  • Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

  • Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

  • Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

 

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer

  • Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

  • Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

  • Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer

  • Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

  • Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

  • Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP

  • Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

  • Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

  • Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Team: regular team events.

Practical information

  • Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

  • If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

Design Transfer & Supply Chain

• Support Design Transfer to Contract Manufacturers, by transferring technical knowledge to industrialization teams, reviewing Work Instructions and pFMEAs, and supporting process-specific tool development.

• Support mechanical supplier selection and qualification, support root-cause analyses for supplier-related quality issues (NC/CAPA).

Medical Device Compliance & Lifecycle

• Maintain full compliance with medical device standards (e.g., ISO 13485, IEC 60601-1, ISO 14971) and author compliant Design History File (DHF) documentation.

o Design for Manufacturability & Assembly (DFM/DFA)

o Design to Cost (DTC)

o CNC Machining & Precision Milling

o Additive Manufacturing / 3D Printing

o Injection Molding

• Cross-Functional & Supplier Management: Strong ability to lead technical execution with external development partners, contract manufacturers, and component vendors, as well as collaborating across interdisciplinary R&D teams (Software, Electrical, Systems, Quality).

• Analytical Problem Solving: Passion for dissecting complex mechanical challenges and engineering elegant, simple, high-reliability solutions for robotics.

  • Run molecular cloning and protein production end to end: PCR, assembly, transformation, expression (bacterial and/or mammalian), and purification.

  • Execute and improve QC on constructs and proteins (capillary electrophoresis, sequencing, SDS-PAGE) and characterization assays (binding, expression, stability).

  • Take a workflow that's flaky or slow and make it reliable and faster — better protocols, better automation, fewer failures.

  • Work hands-on with liquid handlers and lab automation, and help push manual protocols toward automated ones.

  • Bring rigor to your data: document precisely, track samples, and make your results reproducible and traceable.

  • Diagnose failures across biology, reagents, and instruments — and fix them, not just flag them.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong hands already. You've done real molecular biology — PCR, cloning, transformation, electrophoresis, ideally protein expression and purification — through research, a project, or a prior internship, and you're good at it. Protocols don't intimidate you.

  • BSc / MSc student or recent graduate in molecular biology, biochemistry, or a relevant field.

  • Automation- and software-curious. You'd rather automate a tedious step than repeat it 200 times. Comfort with scripting (Python) or liquid-handling automation is a strong plus.

  • Self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting for someone to hand you the next step.

  • AI-native. It's 2026 — you use AI tools as a default to learn faster and work smarter.

  • High standards and high drive. You care that the experiment is right, you move fast, and you're excited that the robots run real customer experiments.

raw.description:
Description

Do you have experience managing carrier networks and want to directly impact commercial success? At CtrlChain, we’re looking for a driven Carrier Account Executive to expand and optimize our carrier network across Europe. 

About us 

Over the past eight years, CtrlChain has built a powerful and trusted ecosystem to simplify and modernize the transport and logistics sector. Now, we're making this ecosystem fully available to our customers, both shippers and carriers. 

Our system brings digital transformation to an industry long reliant on outdated processes, offering smart tools that enhance visibility, streamline compliance, and optimize operations. The result? A more efficient, transparent, and effortless way of working for everyone involved! 

We’re growing fast and expanding our carrier network across Europe. As our network grows, the Carrier Team plays a key role in ensuring carriers are onboarded, activated in our systems, and ready to support our commercial growth. 

The role 

As a Carrier Account Executive, you own a portfolio of carriers and play a key role in expanding capacity, improving margins, and supporting Sales in winning new business. 

You actively build and improve the carrier network, ensuring we have the right capacity, performance, and competitiveness to support growth. You play a key role in improving automation, service KPIs, margins, and win-rate. 

What you’ll do 

Build and scale the carrier network 

  • Proactively expand the carrier base for existing and new lanes  
  • Ensure strong capacity coverage aligned with business needs  
  • Identify and onboard new carriers to improve competitiveness  

Drive onboarding & automation 

  • Onboard and activate carriers in CtrlChain systems  
  • Ensure full system adoption and drive a system-first way of working  
  • Increase automation by ensuring carriers use all relevant tools  

Support Sales & improve win-rate 

  • Work closely with Sales on RFPs and new business  
  • Provide competitive carrier solutions and fast turnaround  
  • Contribute directly to improving win-rate  

Optimize performance & margins 

  • Monitor carrier KPIs and proactively drive improvements  
  • Improve service performance (reliability, responsiveness)  
  • Optimize carrier selection to improve margins  

Deliver insights & improve decisions 

  • Ensure carrier data is accurate, complete, and usable  
  • Provide insights to support pricing, planning, and strategy  
  • Identify structural gaps and improvement opportunities in the network 

Requirements

Who You Are 

You’re commercially aware, proactive, and comfortable working at the intersection of operations and Sales. 

You will thrive in this role if you: 

  • Have 5–8 years of experience in transport, freight forwarding, or logistics coordination. 
  • Have experience with carrier onboarding, communication, and daily operations.  
  • Take a proactive approach to expanding carrier capacity on existing and new lanes.  
  • Are comfortable working with KPIs and continuously improving performance (service, responsiveness, reliability).  
  • Have a system-first mindset and ensure tools are used effectively.  
  • Understand how your work impacts Sales win-rate, margins, and competitiveness.  
  • Are structured, responsive, and take ownership. 
  • Professional level of English and Dutch.
  • Third European language is preferred (ideally German, French, Polish). 

 

Why join CtrlChain? 

  • Direct impact on win-rate, margins, and growth  
  • High ownership and autonomy  
  • Work closely with Sales and commercial teams  
  • Fast-paced scale-up environment  

Benefits

What We Offer 

✔ Competitive salary & benefits
✔ 26 vacation days
✔ Fully paid pension plan & travel allowance
✔ Vitality Allowance & daily office lunches
✔ A high-performance, collaborative sales culture
✔ The opportunity to shape the future of digital logistics

Ready to Join Us? 

Apply now and grow your career as a Carrier Account Executive at CtrlChain!

Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en technische diepgang vinden we belangrijker dan een perfecte checklist. Als niche-consultancyteam onderscheiden we ons van de grote spelers: we leveren kwaliteit boven kwantiteit en willen een thought leader in ons vakgebied zijn. Voor onze klanten richten we ons op het creëren van businesswaarde met innovatieve datasolutions die een duurzame impact hebben. title: Projectleider Cybersecurity Congres | RDI
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI ) op zoek naar een ervaren Projectleider . De RDI zet zich in voor een veilig verbonden Nederland en werkt aan actuele thema’s zoals cyberveiligheid, digitale weerbaarheid, AI, 5G en digitale infrastructuur. De opdracht vindt plaats binnen de directie Digitale Weerbaarheid en richt zich op de organisatie van de NISDUC 2027 (NIS Directive User Community), een internationaal congres op het gebied van digitale weerbaarheid, cybersecurity en toezicht. Tijdens dit congres komen toezichthouders, overheden en professionals uit Nederland, België en Luxemburg samen om kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen rondom onder meer NIS2 en cybersecurity. Als Projectleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en organisatorische aansturing van het congres en zorg je voor een succesvolle realisatie van het programma en de samenwerking met alle betrokken partijen. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je voert de projectleiding over het volledige programma van NISDUC 2027. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de organisatie van het internationale cybersecuritycongres. Je ontwikkelt, beheert en vult de verschillende programmalijnen en tracks. Je stemt af met betrokken overheidsorganisaties, toezichthouders en partners. Je organiseert internationale kennisuitwisseling en samenwerking binnen het congresprogramma. Je stuurt het betrokken evenementenbureau aan. Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit, voortgang en resultaten van het congres. Je draagt zorg voor een professioneel en inhoudelijk sterk programma rondom digitale weerbaarheid en cybersecurity Wat vragen wij? Eisen: Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als projectleider. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen het cybersecuritydomein. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het aansturen van de organisatie van inhoudelijke congressen. Je hebt ervaring met complexe opdrachten en omvangrijke trajecten met een hoog afbreukrisico. Je bent in het bezit van een projectmanagementcertificering. Aanvullende wensen: Je hebt ervaring als projectleider binnen de Rijksoverheid. Je hebt ervaring met het organiseren van cybersecurity-events. Je hebt ervaring met samenwerkingspartners binnen het cybersecuritydomein, zoals het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC). Competenties Je bent bestuurlijk sensitief. Je bent communicatief sterk. Je bent creatief in het ontwikkelen van programma’s en oplossingen. Je beschikt over organisatiesensitiviteit. Je weet verschillende belangen effectief samen te brengen. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van een publieke organisatie en beweegt je gemakkelijk binnen een complexe stakeholderomgeving. Informatie  Start: 2 november 2026 Aantal uur: 16 tot 20 uur per week Lengte opdracht: 8 maanden Locatie: Amersfoort Vorm: ZZP Schaalniveau: 14 Geïnteresseerd? Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 26 oktober 9.00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht. Contact Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kunt u contact opnemen met Leonie van Hove, Managing Consultant Interim Management, 06 45 39 02 31, Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Cosmetic Chemist
description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Cosmetic Chemist for our KEUNE Beauty Solutions team. You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market. At KEUNE, we develop and manufacture not only our own professional haircare products but also products for KEUNE Beauty Solutions (KBS), our private label division. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products. MISSION Lead assigned new product development projects from brief to commercialization, taking ownership of technical execution, deliverables, timelines, and follow-up in line with the NPD process. Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan. Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps. Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes. Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked. Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders. Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control. Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients. Apply appropriate instrumental and analytical methods to evaluate formulations, substantiate performance, and support technical decisions. YOU Master's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, or a related field. At least 7 years of relevant cosmetic formulation and development experience, with strong expertise in hair products. A proven track record of developing and successfully launching cosmetic products. Strong hands-on formulation skills, paired with the ability to organize and tackle multiple development activities. A proactive, independent, and accountable working style: you take initiative, follow through on commitments, and know when to escalate issues. Confidence in leading technical client conversations, challenging or clarifying briefs constructively, and managing expectations together with cross-functional colleagues. Ability to guide junior and mid-level chemists. Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders. Curiosity about innovation, new ingredients, and opportunities to improve products and ways of working. Eligible to work in the Netherlands OUR OFFER A sustainably-conscious employer; Travel allowance 27 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment); Relocation support A good pension plan; A competitive salary; 8% holiday pay; And never have a "bad hair day" again thanks to staff discounts on the entire Keune collection! Attention to your mental well-being through unlimited access to OpenUp Participation in group classes at Personal Fitness Soest KEUNE We are a family business with a long-term vision, where science is at the heart of everything we do. Our story begins in 1922, in Amsterdam. Today, KEUNE belongs to one of the fastest growing brands in professional hair care products. From our headquarters in Soest, KEUNE products are developed, produced and distributed worldwide to more than 85 countries. And we have no intention of slowing down! Every year we open a new site of our own. We produce in a sustainable and animal-friendly way and are B Corp-certified. But KEUNE is not just about creating beautiful products - it's about our story and our vision. KEUNE is led by Philip Berlijn, who is focused on building a strong brand and creating a corporate culture that is all about collaboration, sustainability and showing character OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, age, disability, neurodiversity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to support your participation. title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | International E-commerce | Remote ASAP
description: ennovationHUB is a rapidly growing international e-commerce group operating in the home & living category, with a strong focus on furniture. From our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers across the UK, North America, EU, and APAC. As we work toward €160m+ annual revenue by 2027, we are looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us ASAP and take ownership of Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, and profitability. This is not a typical agency PPC role focused on managing a handful of campaigns. You will join a multi-brand international e-commerce group with significant advertising budgets, multiple markets, and a clear view of how your work influences revenue and profitability. Google Ads is central to our growth strategy. Working across multiple countries and brands brings both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for people who enjoy working with large datasets, identifying performance opportunities, and consistently improving results through testing, analysis, and execution. You will collaborate closely with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists to ensure campaigns perform well today and continue to scale efficiently as the business grows. Take ownership of Google Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience segments Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance You will be joining a business where Google Ads already delivers results. Your role is to build on that success by identifying opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where even small improvements can have a significant impact. You will work alongside experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support or reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and directly influence the growth of the business. This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Applicants whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered. We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes within an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and feel comfortable taking responsibility for results, beyond simply providing recommendations. Our Ideal Candidate Will Have: 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability Strong experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center Highly analytical with strong attention to detail Fluent in English, both written and spoken Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement Able to take ownership and make decisions independently We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change Senior, but practical Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements Focused on outcomes rather than activity Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns Available to start immediately / ASAP We are investing in strengthening our presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. The role involves travel approximately every 4-8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work takes place remotely, we value spending time together in person, particularly as the company continues to scale. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to make a meaningful contribution to scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years. In Our Culture at ennovationHUB, We Value: Accountability over excuses Execution over talk Clarity over politics Learning through doing We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. What matters most is the quality of your work, taking ownership, and helping the business move forward. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

  • Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations

  • Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives

  • Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement

  • Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness

  • Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices

  • Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance

You will be joining a business where Google Ads already delivers results. Your role is to build on that success by identifying opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where even small improvements can have a significant impact.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support or reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and directly influence the growth of the business.


This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Applicants whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes within an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and feel comfortable taking responsibility for results, beyond simply providing recommendations.

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns

  • Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability

  • Strong experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns

  • Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer

  • Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights

  • Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center

  • Highly analytical with strong attention to detail

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities

  • Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement

  • Able to take ownership and make decisions independently

  • We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change

  • Senior, but practical

  • Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions

  • Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements

  • Focused on outcomes rather than activity

  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns

  • Available to start immediately / ASAP

We are investing in strengthening our presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team works across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou.

The role involves travel approximately every 4-8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work takes place remotely, we value spending time together in person, particularly as the company continues to scale.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to make a meaningful contribution to scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years.

In Our Culture at ennovationHUB, We Value:

  • Accountability over excuses

  • Execution over talk

  • Clarity over politics

  • Learning through doing

We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. What matters most is the quality of your work, taking ownership, and helping the business move forward.

title: Senior Financial Controller
description: MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken. Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie. Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie. MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten. Verantwoordelijkheden Project Control Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts. Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren. Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow. Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting. Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen. Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie. Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering. Financial Control Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen. Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces. Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting. Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie. Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages. Business Control & Business Partnering Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning. Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses. Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie. Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning. Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's. Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming. Wie zoeken wij? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar. Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie. Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen. Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants. Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving. Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing. Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools. Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré. Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht. In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders. Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering. Wat bieden wij? Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie. Wij bieden je: Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Een internationale werkomgeving met collega's en projecten over de hele wereld. Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een marktconform salaris conform de cao Architectenbureaus, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring. 30 vakantiedagen, hybride werken en een inspirerende werkplek in Rotterdam. Onbeperkte toegang tot OpenUp, korting met Urban Sports, een gezonde lunch geserveerd, een NS Business Card en een laptop. Klaar om mee te bouwen aan een financieel sterke toekomst voor MVRDV? We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

  • Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

  • Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

  • Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

  • Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

  • Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

  • Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

  • Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

  • You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

  • You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

  • You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

  • You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

  • You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

  • You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

  • International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability.

  • Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.  

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 

  • Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 

  • Hybrid working model. 

  • Policies to support working parents. 

  • Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office.  

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp  

  • Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. title: Social Creative stage
description: Als stagiair Social Creative heb je een schermtijd die je liever niet hardop zegt en ben je altijd op de hoogte van de laatste social media trends. Van feta-ovenpasta tot knapperige aardappelsalade en van chopped sandwich tot de omelet uit The Bear - jij was er allemaal als eerste bij. Je maakt foto’s en short-form video’s waar menig maag van gaat rommelen en je weet deze beelden tot hapklare content te maken. Kom jij ons gezellige social team per februari 2027 versterken voor een half jaar? Wat je gaat doen Je bent als eerste op de hoogte van de nieuwste foodtrends en komt met originele ideeën om hierop in te haken op een manier die past bij Crisp. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid om je eigen creativiteit in te zetten. Je weet welke ingrediënten er nodig zijn om de lekkerste foto’s en video’s te maken en kunt deze beelden zelf bewerken tot smaakmakende content. Met je handen uit de mouwen mentaliteit ondersteun je ons social team bij het coördineren van foto en videoshoots. Je zit niet elke dag achter je laptop, maar gaat ook regelmatig op pad, bijvoorbeeld om leveranciers te ontmoeten of content te schieten op locatie. Je helpt bij het beheren van de social media kanalen van Crisp. Je houdt de planning bij, zorgt dat alles op rolletjes loopt en draagt bij aan een dynamische, leuke rol binnen een gezellig team. Dit ben jij Je zit vol ideeën om onze socials naar een next level te tillen Je verslindt alle vormen van digitale content en Instagram en TikTok kennen geen geheimen voor jou. Je hebt een flexibele werkhouding. Een plotselinge update van Instagram brengt jou niet van je stuk. Je bent creatief en proactief. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar sparren met het social team vind je net zo leuk. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als in schrift. Je bent 32-40 uur per week beschikbaar voor minimaal 5 maanden. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen. Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren. Een kijkje in de keuken van een van de snelst ontwikkelende bedrijven in de Europese markt. Een gratis lunch van Crisp. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. The main objective of this role is to help customers find the right answers and solve their issues. You'll be the first point of contact when customers reach out, whether they're new to the platform and need guidance or veterans troubleshooting complex issues. You'll make a real impact by solving problems, sharing insights, and ensuring our customers get fast, top-quality support when they need it most. As a repository of customer feedback and input, you'll advocate for our customers internally so that we continue to be a customer-centric company that listens to its users.   • Strong experience with Fortinet FortiGate or Palo Alto Networks firewalls, and the willingness to master the other
